api.cli: sensefog_pairing.py --input PATH --expected-input-sha256 SHA256 --output FRESH_PATH --max-input-bytes B --max-output-bytes O --max-cases N

fixed_math: H includes the entire2s core and maximum authorized causal support. L_train is established using exactly outer-training people. G=max(30*rate,2*H,L_train), using pre-established integer sample ceilings; choose the smallest allowed G. Emit all+G,-G,...,+10G,-10G. Missing H/L_train yields explicit unsupported maps rather than substituted shifts.
join_obligation: Reuse one frozen input/map hash in every arm. Later protected paired-loss consumer must enforce identical supported case IDs across arms and equal-person paired differences. Target-class strata are reported only after map freezing. This component does not authenticate that later join.
logical_bounds: All JSON/masks/output rows are materialized. User-declared complete byte/case caps reject over-limit work, never truncate. No hard OS or aggregate memory/CPU guarantee, native qualification, ownership supervisor, automatic retry or atomic output commit. Preserve a partial fresh output on write failure.
outputs: All20 maps per original recording-grid case; every original_case_id; all12 people; every recording and segment/lag including zero cases; explicit missing-recording/core-boundary/history/donor-boundary/mask/dependence reasons; requested and distinct-supported transform counts. No primary score or qualification.
remaining_holds: Authentic complete source/census and person/segment/channel/mask bindings
Training-only dependence estimation, authorized lookback, ex-ante freeze and causal mask provenance
Class dictionary/clinical annotation clocks and complete primary scoring
Actual signal extraction/projection, equal-arm physical packet identity and protected paired-loss consumer
Reference/model, uncertainty, clinical interpretation and exposure qualification

strict_input.acquisition_stratum: Evaluator-authenticated complete constant montage/channel set, reference/filter regime, medication,DBS and any other acquisition state. No inferred conditions or label-driven boundaries. Segment boundaries already encode all actual gaps/changes.
strict_input.cases: Every complete2s case on the frozen RECORDING grid in increasing start_sample order, each with opaque case_id. Grid origin/extent/stride are explicit and independently authenticated before outcomes. Boundary/gap crossing cases remain present with unsupported maps.
strict_input.folds: Exactly one per person; heldout_person, training_people (exact other11), lookback_samples_by_rate, dependence_samples_by_rate and method_receipt_sha256. Rate keys are decimal positive integer Hz. Values are integer sample ceilings or null. A receipt-shaped hash alone is not provenance proof.
strict_input.forbidden: Unknown fields are refused at all typed object boundaries; targets, gait labels, annotations, scores, arbitrary lag selection and channel-specific lags have no interface.
strict_input.masks: Exactly all declared channels, each complete contiguous RLE [start,end,missing_boolean,artifact_boolean] over [0,sample_count). Equivalent adjacent runs coalesce.
strict_input.participants: Exactly12 unique opaque identities, independently authenticated across sessions.
strict_input.recording: recording_id,participant,day_id,session_id,sample_rate_hz,sample_count,window_stride_samples,window_origin_sample,cases. This independently defines the trusted original grid, including missing spans or entire missing recordings. All12 people require recording accounting. Each recording uses one authenticated constant native integer-Hz sample grid.
strict_input.segment: segment_id,recording_id,acquisition_stratum,recording_start_sample,sample_count,channels,masks. Positive-length observed segments are contained, nonoverlapping intervals of the parent recording. They do not own or generate the original case roster. Zero observed segments is representable without dropping the recording.

support: All intervals are recording-relative. A full core and complete support must fit one identical continuous segment; otherwise retain an unsupported row for every lag. Within a segment the donor shifts every channel/support by the same lag. Masks are compared on complete local support. No wrap, re-anchoring, gap stitching, interpolation or held-label access.
